## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; weak overall breadth plus narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Top performers from Technology) confirm mixed market signals, so reduce conviction and trade selectively.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND; Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: DOW (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +3.93%) ABOVE TREND is an exception but Materials overall show weakness; Consumer Staples lag with EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare soft with LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in cyclicals/materials and select staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — three large caps with 1W ≠ 1M suggest tactical but not structural shifts; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but internally bifurcated: NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND and SHOP (1W: +7.84% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND versus AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -4.25% | 1M: -10.37%) BELOW TREND — sector shows dispersion and internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Weak on the week: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND; Financials are a source of downside risk within the CAUTION regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Slipping: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION — defensive names showing short-term pullbacks despite some 1M strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Operate with reduced conviction: favor selective Energy and the handful of ABOVE TREND techs (INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broken names in Materials/Staples (EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-driven follow-through likely; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND — energy momentum.  
BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside and breadth deterioration.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy — sector return positive and multiple names ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples — widening weakness and several large drawdowns.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA 1M trend support (~650) — failure would widen rotation away from Growth; AAPL support (~165) — breach would signal broader tech weakness; INTU near prior breakout zone (~720) — sustained hold would confirm leadership continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (+55): INTU stock surge post-earnings aligns with price action — INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
PFE (+75): Pfizer headline bullish but price in CORRECTION — PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — sentiment diverging from short-term price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (-50): Negative headlines around regulatory/AI supply issues but NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — bearish sentiment currently diverging from price.  
F (-60): Ford recall news and price weakness align — F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
WMT (-55): Downgrade and FTC settlement pressure match price weakness — WMT (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA in RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment (PFE bullish despite short-term weakness; NVDA negative headlines but ABOVE TREND).
